traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Butomaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; blades linear; leaf rosettes basal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; stems herbaceous; flowers in umbels; flowers actinomorphic; perianth usually tepals, often sepals and petals; fruit follicle; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 9; carpels 6. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
